liste.aide: notice what is running out and what is going off, plan the meals, keep the list, not forgetting the house: washing powder, toilet roll, light bulbs

courses.aide: the shop, the market or click and collect, carrying, putting it all away at home, returns

cuisiner.aide: choose what to eat, cook breakfast, lunch and dinner

vaisselle.nom: Clear the table and do the washing-up

poubelles.aide: put them out, bring them in, change the bags, recycling, compost if you have it

lits.aide: all the beds, bath towels and tea towels

gros-nettoyage.aide: windows, fridge, oven, cupboards, appliances: a few times a year

tri.nom: Sort out, tidy away, give away what's no longer used

machines.aide: sort, treat stains, start the machine, hang out or tumble dry

ranger-linge.aide: fold, put away in wardrobes and drawers

gros-linge.aide: duvets, pillows, curtains, sofa covers, a few times a year

taches.aide: mending, dry cleaner's, shoe repairs, alterations

matin.nom: Get the children ready in the morning
matin.aide: getting up, getting dressed, bags, school bag

gouter-devoirs.nom: After-school snack, homework, end of the day

bain.nom: Do bath time and brush teeth

bebe.aide: breastfeeding or bottles, baby food, nappies and changing; ‘neither of us’ if there is no baby at home

nuits.aide: getting up for a child who wakes, a nightmare, a bottle, a poorly child

jouer.nom: Play, go out, read with the children

garde.aide: after school, at weekends, in the evenings: being the one who is there

malade.aide: staying at home, the GP, medicine

ecole.aide: home-school diary or app, emails, parents' evenings, school trips, forms to sign, school supplies

sante-enfants.nom: Keep track of the children's health

activites.aide: signing up, timetables, kit, getting them there

mode-garde.aide: childminder, nursery, after-school club, grandparents, school holidays

anniversaires-enfants.aide: your children's, and their friends': invitations, presents, being there

ecrans-regles.nom: Set and keep the rules with the children
ecrans-regles.aide: screens, sleep, discipline, the difficult conversations

papiers.nom: Deal with the admin and paperwork

amis.nom: Keep in touch with friends and family

plantes.nom: Look after the plants, garden or balcony

source: Catalogue v2. Families aligned with the categories of the INSEE (French national statistics office) 2010 Time Use survey (cooking, cleaning, laundry, shopping, running the household, care and education of children, DIY, gardening, pets, help for adults), supplemented by the 100 Fair Play cards (Rodsky, 2019) for what the time diary does not capture (calendar, presents, school, photos, loved ones). Labels in everyday language, with nothing specific to any one household. Default durations calibrated on INSEE 2010: a couple with children should come out between 6 and 9 hours a day.
